caption:
Google rewrote what your Business Profile can say.

As of October 6, your listing can't carry pricing, time-bound offers, or "call now" language. That's part of Google's prohibited content policy.

Here's what to do this week:

1. Open your profile and remove price mentions, "today only," and direct CTAs from your business description.

2. Move any current offer into a Google Post instead. Offers are still allowed there, but not your phone number, email, or social links.

3. Keep the listing focused on what you do, where you work, and who you serve.

The real shift: your listing opens the door, but it can't close the sale anymore. Once that click turns into a call or message, your response time decides if it becomes a customer.

Check your own response speed this week.
